name: This_11
short_caption: The robot extends its right arm forward with an open palm to point out or present something.
movement_description: The robot starts from its neutral standing posture and raises its right arm forward and slightly to the right, opening its hand palm-upwards. The head tilts slightly towards the right hand as it reaches its peak extension. After a brief pause to emphasize the gesture, the right arm smoothly retracts and returns to the neutral hanging position alongside the left arm.
safety_notes: The robot extends its right arm forward, requiring a clear path of about 40-50 cm in front and slightly to the right side.
